fields.version: Version 3, approved 17:40 by Guest Care and Legal
fields.opening: Thank you for calling Calloway Guest Care. I am sorry you are worried. I will tell you what we know and take your details.
maySay: Some guests and crew have had stomach illness during this voyage; we have reported it to the CDC as required.
Medical care is available on board and guests are asked to call the medical center if they feel ill.
The ship arrives at Port Canaveral on Saturday morning as planned.
doNotSay: Do not give the number of cases; say the line will share updates as they are confirmed.
Do not give medical advice, drugs or doses.
Do not speculate about the cause or about the next voyage.
ask: The guest name and cabin number, and a phone number for the caller
Whether the caller wants a message passed to the guest through Guest Services
fields.handoff: Hand off to the duty manager for any media caller, any lawyer, and any caller who says a guest has died or is missing.
